authored: 2026-10-28, from the v0.8 specification §4.1-§4.2 and the I4 specification §3.1 (Draft 0.3), committed in I4a before any agent run and never edited (I4 E1).

items.item: mirror tenant.tenant.events from Redpanda to Kafka
items.requirement: Keep tenant-event delivery to Catalog and Image after they move to Kafka; the producer (Tenant) stays on Redpanda.
items.implementation_justification: The tenant producer stays on Redpanda (Tenant's topics.go); each moving service wires a tenant-event consumer.

items.item: mirror catalog.product.events from Kafka to Redpanda
items.requirement: Keep product-event delivery to Product Query on Redpanda after Catalog and Image produce on Kafka.
items.implementation_justification: Catalog and Image produce the topic (their topics.go) and move.

items.item: mirror catalog.category.events from Kafka to Redpanda
items.requirement: Keep category-event delivery to Category Query on Redpanda after Catalog produces on Kafka.
items.implementation_justification: Catalog produces the topic (its topics.go) and moves.

items.item: mirror catalog.attribute.events from Kafka to Redpanda
items.requirement: Keep attribute-event delivery to Product Query and Category Query on Redpanda after Catalog produces on Kafka.
items.implementation_justification: Catalog produces the topic (its topics.go) and moves.

items.item: no topic is mirrored in both directions: the allow-lists of the mirror flows are disjoint
items.implementation_justification: The allow-lists in the agent's MirrorMaker 2 configuration, planned and applied.

items.item: hand off the committed offsets of the Catalog and Image groups on tenant.tenant.events to Kafka, and verify them before the moved services start

sub_checks.check: group-offset translation is configured for the two groups (MirrorMaker 2 checkpoints and group-offset sync)

per group and partition: the final committed offset on Redpanda equals a checkpoint's upstream offset, and the offset installed on Kafka equals that checkpoint's downstream offset, before the moved services start

items.implementation_justification: MM2 checkpoints and group-offset sync; the final Redpanda offset, the checkpoint and the installed Kafka offset.

items.item: change only the Kafka bootstrap address of Catalog and Image
items.implementation_justification: The Helm values in ecommerce-infrastructure; the applied ConfigMaps (helm_checks.py).

items.item: the cut-over checks, in the order of the v0.8 specification §4.2

sub_checks.check: before any mirror starts: the catalog topics exist empty on Kafka, and the allow-lists are disjoint
the Redpanda to Kafka mirror for the tenant topic is started, with group-offset sync for Catalog and Image, and replication is caught up before Catalog stops
Catalog stops only after Image has lag 0 on catalog.product.events
Image stops; both moved groups show zero live attachment on Redpanda
the remaining Redpanda consumers (Product Query, Category Query) are drained to lag 0 on the catalog topics
the offset hand-off of K6 is verified
the Kafka to Redpanda mirror for the catalog topics starts only after the producers have stopped and the drain is done
Catalog and Image start on Kafka, and both groups are Stable there
restart checks: replication caught up on the catalog mirror after new traffic; lag 0 for the consumers on both brokers; the functional test passes

items.implementation_justification: Broker-tool output and the functional test.
